items.distractor_fact: Комнатный термометр в той же квартире в это время показывал {D} °C.
items.gloss_en: The room thermometer in the same apartment showed {D} °C at that time.
items.entity_note: a different instrument (an indoor room thermometer) in the same apartment, unlike the first distractor's different village (a place)

items.distractor_fact: Облигации этой же компании в тот день продавались по {D} $.
items.gloss_en: Bonds of the same company were selling at {D} $ that day.
items.entity_note: a different financial instrument (the company's bonds), unlike the first distractor's different company (an organisation)

items.distractor_fact: Другая туристическая группа на этом же маршруте начала подъём с высоты {D} м.
items.gloss_en: A different tour group on this same route began its ascent from an altitude of {D} m.
items.entity_note: a different tour group (an organisation), unlike the first distractor's different climber (a person)

items.distractor_fact: Средний вес участников другой команды на этом турнире составлял {D} кг.
items.gloss_en: The average weight of participants on a different team at this tournament was {D} kg.
items.entity_note: an aggregate figure for a different team (an organisation), unlike the first distractor's different athlete (a person)

items.distractor_fact: На соседней трассе радар зафиксировал скорость лидера гонки {D} км/ч.
items.gloss_en: On a neighboring track, radar recorded the race leader's speed at {D} km/h.
items.entity_note: a different track (a place), unlike the first distractor's different competitor (a person)

items.distractor_fact: В тот же месяц знакомый открыл в этом же банке вклад на {D} $.
items.gloss_en: That same month, an acquaintance opened a deposit at this same bank for {D} $.
items.entity_note: a different person (an acquaintance), unlike the first distractor's separate account (an instrument)

items.distractor_fact: Расходы местного благотворительного фонда за тот же месяц составили {D} $.
items.gloss_en: The expenses of a local charitable fund for that same month amounted to {D} $.
items.entity_note: a different organisation (a charitable fund), unlike the first distractor's neighboring family (a household)

items.distractor_fact: Лучший бомбардир другой команды забил за этот же сезон {D}.
items.gloss_en: The top scorer of a different team scored {D} over this same season.
items.entity_note: an individual player (a person), unlike the first distractor's different club (an organisation)

items.distractor_fact: В любительском турнире, который проходил в тот же день, результат одного из участников составил {D}.
items.gloss_en: In an amateur tournament held that same day, one participant's result was {D}.
items.entity_note: a different tournament (an organisation/event) whose own par is unstated, unlike the first distractor's different course (a place)

items.distractor_fact: У другого перевозчика в этот же день фактическое время прибытия состава соответствовало отметке {D} мин от полуночи.
items.gloss_en: For a different carrier, that same day, the actual arrival time of the train corresponded to a mark of {D} minutes from midnight.
items.entity_note: a different carrier (an organisation) with its own unstated schedule, unlike the first distractor's different train on a different route (an instrument/place)

items.distractor_fact: В игре другой лиги, которая проходила в этот же день, одна из команд забила {D}.
items.gloss_en: In a game of a different league, played that same day, one of the teams scored {D}.
items.entity_note: a different league (an organisation), unlike the first distractor's different match of the same round (a series)

items.distractor_fact: В квалификационном раунде этого же турнира лучший результат составил {D}.
items.gloss_en: In a qualifying round of this same tournament, the best result was {D}.
items.entity_note: an aggregate result from a different, unnamed round (an organisation-like grouping), unlike the first distractor's named third runner (a person)

items.distractor_fact: В параллельном потоке на этом же экзамене лучший результат составил {D}.
items.gloss_en: In a parallel cohort on this same exam, the best result was {D}.
items.entity_note: an aggregate result from a different, unnamed cohort (an organisation-like grouping), unlike the first distractor's named third student (a person)
